cs.t: I use an Eames lounge an adjustable keyboard arm and a cantilevered UHD monitor. I've got a foam roller that I use some times to sit on a little higher or behind my back if I want to push the chair back and not be in a reclined position. It has helped my repetitive strain immensely. I don't know that I'd recommend it to other people though. I have specific arm problems and I'm also an idiot.
cs.th: Ask HN: What office chair do you use for long hour sitting?
